request.voice_description: Female, 34, Black British illusionist from south London. Original flamboyant adult game character. Unusually low, dark contralto with a smoky, dry rasp; rich chest resonance and incisive bright consonants. Educated London phrasing over audible south London roots. Sensual and imperious, never soft background narration. A close teasing purr can suddenly open into a huge ringing stage command; an ugly delighted laugh briefly tears through immaculate diction. When genuinely afraid, all the ornament vanishes and her voice becomes small and direct. Human grain, no electronic effects, no ASMR monotone, no smooth audiobook delivery. Clean close studio speech.

characters.title: Marlowe · A ruined tenor with immaculate manners

request.voice_description: Male, appears 63, from near Leeds in northern England. Original casino bartender character. A narrow, weather-beaten middle-register tenor, papery rasp and a faint reedy whistle in breath; lower notes unexpectedly warm and intimate. Clearly distinct from deep gangster voices. Soft Yorkshire vowels, clipped practical consonants, wonderfully uneven dry timing. Courteous words carry impudent private delight. Usually speaks close and plain, but a tiny affront can produce a sudden piercing bark before manners return. A dusty almost involuntary chuckle, lived-in wit and surprising emotional bite. Heightened character acting, never a sleepy old narrator, whisper-only voice or generic butler. A shameful admission loses the clever timing. No actor imitation or audio effects. Dry clean studio speech.
